title: [Epic] Profile Pages Redesign - Professional & Consistent
description:
Redesign both auth.defcon.run and run.defcon.run profile/dashboard pages to be professional, consistent siblings.

## Mental Model

**Dashboard = "Who Am I?"** — Quick identity overview. Same visual layout in both apps. Shows session claims, linked providers, services.
**Profile = "What Can I Do/Manage?"** — Different per app based on what it owns.

| Route | Purpose | Content |
|---|---|---|
| auth.defcon.run / (dashboard) | Who Am I? | Identity, session, linked providers, services. Clean. |
| auth.defcon.run /profile | Identity Management | Detailed linked accounts, masked tokens/emails, security controls, debug |
| run.defcon.run /dashboard | Who Am I? | Same visual as auth dashboard, but OIDC-sourced claims |
| run.defcon.run /profile | App Config | Radios, quotas, QR, MQTT — permissions and settings for run.human |

## Current Problems (the "rainbow")
Both dashboard pages use a different hardcoded color per icon field:
- Shield=blue, User=green, Mail=purple, Clock=orange, Hash=pink, Timer=teal, Layers=cyan, Link2=indigo
- Manual isDarkTheme ternaries everywhere instead of HeroUI semantic colors (text-foreground, text-default-500, etc.)
- text-effects/Common imports (Heading/Text) add indirection for no benefit

## Design Rules
- ALL pages use HeroUI components + semantic colors (text-foreground, text-default-500, bg-default-100)
- ALL icons use ONE consistent color: text-default-500 (or text-primary for action items)
- NO isDarkTheme ternaries — HeroUI handles dark mode through semantic tokens
- NO text-effects/Common imports — use plain HTML tags with Tailwind
- Consistent card structure: Card > CardHeader > Divider > CardBody
- Max width: max-w-2xl mx-auto, space-y-4 between cards
- Provider icons: react-icons/si (SiDiscord, SiGithub, SiStrava) — already used in run.human dashboard

## Key Files
- auth dashboard (current): apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/(authlogin)/page.tsx (286 lines)
- auth profile API: NEEDS CREATION — apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/api/profile/route.ts
- auth profile page: NEEDS CREATION — apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/(authlogin)/profile/page.tsx
- run.human dashboard (current): apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/(protected)/dashboard/page.tsx (350 lines)
- run.human profile (current): apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx (298 lines)
- AuthProfile entity: apps/run.auth/webapp/src/entities/auth-profile.ts (315 lines)
- RunUser entity: apps/run.human/webapp/src/entities/run-user.ts (361 lines)
- User API: apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/api/user/route.ts (90 lines)
- MeshtasticRadios: apps/run.human/webapp/src/components/profile/MeshtasticRadios.tsx (643 lines, keep unchanged)

title: Redesign run.defcon.run /profile as App Config page
description:
Redesign the existing profile page at apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx to focus on app-specific configuration and permissions — NOT identity (that lives on /dashboard now).

## Mental model shift
- Dashboard = "Who Am I?" (identity, providers, services)
- Profile = "What can I do?" (quotas, radios, QR, MQTT — the things you configure in run.human)

## Current problems
1. Identity info (avatar, name, email, linked services) duplicated here AND on dashboard
2. 11 quota boxes copy-pasted inline (6 lines each of identical JSX)
3. Collapsed by default — user sees almost nothing
4. No visual grouping of related quotas

## Target design — App Config / Permissions page

### Section 1: Account Summary (compact, NOT duplicate of dashboard)
- Small card: displayName + MQTT username in mono
- NO avatar, NO email, NO linked services (those are on /dashboard)
- Link: "View identity on Dashboard" (subtle)

### Section 2: Quotas (MAIN content — the reason to visit /profile)
- Card titled "Quotas"
- Group into 3 visual sections with text-xs uppercase labels:
  **Uploads**: file_upload (Files), gpx_upload (GPX Uploads), gpx_save (GPX Saves), gpx_share (GPX Shares), photo_upload (Photos)
  **Activity**: checkin (Check-ins), strava_sync (Strava Syncs), qr_scan (QR Scans)
  **System**: meshtastic_radio (Radio Slots), displayname_change (Name Changes), qr_sheet (QR Sheets)
- Render from config array, NOT copy-pasted:
  ```tsx
  const quotaGroups = [
    { label: 'Uploads', items: [
      { key: 'file_upload', label: 'Files' },
      { key: 'gpx_upload', label: 'GPX Uploads' },
      // ...
    ]},
    // ...
  ];
  ```
- Keep visual style: big remaining number (text-primary) / small initial (text-default-400), label below
- Grid: grid-cols-3 per group

### Section 3: Meshtastic Radios
- Keep MeshtasticRadios component UNCHANGED
- Same props as current

### Section 4: QR Code
- Keep existing QR card UNCHANGED

## Styling rules
- HeroUI components only, no text-effects
- Semantic colors (text-foreground, text-default-500, bg-default-100)
- Max width: max-w-2xl mx-auto
- space-y-4 between cards
- Details visible by default (no collapse for quotas)
- ~150 lines target (currently 298, with deduplication)

## Files
- apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx (rewrite)
- apps/run.human/webapp/src/app/api/user/route.ts (no changes needed)
- apps/run.human/webapp/src/components/profile/MeshtasticRadios.tsx (no changes)

title: Create auth.defcon.run /api/profile endpoint
description:
Create a new API route at apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/api/profile/route.ts that serves the authenticated user's full AuthProfile data for the profile page.

## What to build

GET /api/profile — Returns the authenticated user's AuthProfile from DynamoDB.

## Authentication
Use the existing session pattern (same as /api/session/validate/route.ts). Get session from NextAuth, extract user.id, fetch AuthProfile.

## Response shape
{
  "user": {
    "userId": "...",
    "displayName": "rabbit_XXXX",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "emailVerified": true,
    "name": "Display Name",
    "picture": "https://...",
    "createdAt": 1234567890,
    "updatedAt": 1234567890,
    "quotaTier": "upload",
    "lockedOut": false,
    "services": ["auth", "run", "strava", "gpxstudio"],
    "sessionVersion": 1,
    "linkedAccounts": {
      "discord": {
        "linked": true,
        "username": "user#1234",
        "globalName": "Display Name",
        "avatarUrl": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/...",
        "email": "u***@gmail.com",  // MASKED
        "linkedAt": "2025-12-15T..."
      },
      "github": {
        "linked": true,
        "login": "username",
        "name": "Full Name",
        "avatarUrl": "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/...",
        "email": "u***@github.com",  // MASKED
        "linkedAt": "2025-12-15T..."
      },
      "strava": {
        "linked": false
      }
    }
  }
}

## Masking logic
Email masking: show first char + "***" + "@" + domain. Example: "khundeck@gmail.com" → "k***@gmail.com"
Do NOT expose: raw provider profiles (discordProfile, githubProfile, stravaProfile), provider OAuth tokens, rsapub/priv, seed

## Key files to reference
- Entity: apps/run.auth/webapp/src/entities/auth-profile.ts (getAuthProfile function)
- Session pattern: apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/api/session/validate/route.ts
- Existing profile API: apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/api/profile/mapbox-token/route.ts (for auth pattern)

title: CMS admin shows raw Strapi login before OIDC redirect
description:
## Observed behavior
1. User is authenticated on auth.defcon.run (valid session)
2. Navigate to cms.defcon.run/use1/ for the first time
3. Strapi's native username/password admin login form appears
4. Refresh the page → OIDC redirect kicks in, but returns "unauthorized"
5. Subsequent refreshes work correctly

## Expected behavior
First visit should immediately OIDC-redirect (never show Strapi's native login form).

## Likely cause
Race condition in CMS SSO middleware initialization. The Strapi admin panel serves its SPA before the OIDC middleware intercepts. On refresh, the middleware is loaded and takes over, but the session/cookies from step 3 may confuse the flow.

Possible issues:
- Strapi admin register/login routes not properly blocked
- OIDC middleware loads async and misses the first request
- Cookie domain mismatch between auth.defcon.run and cms.defcon.run on first load
- The "unauthorized" on first OIDC redirect may be a missing or expired grant

## Files to investigate
- apps/run.cms/app/src/admin/ — Strapi admin customization
- apps/run.cms/app/src/plugins/ — OIDC SSO plugin
- apps/run.cms/app/config/middlewares.ts — middleware ordering
- apps/run.auth/webapp/src/config/oidc.ts — CMS client registration (lines ~60-80)

## Steps to reproduce
1. Clear cookies for cms.defcon.run
2. Log in at auth.defcon.run
3. Navigate to cms.defcon.run/use1/
4. Observe Strapi native login form
5. Refresh page
6. Observe OIDC redirect + "unauthorized" error
close_reason: Fixed: removed setTimeout delay, hide document before immediate SSO redirect

title: Create auth.defcon.run /profile page
description:
Create a new profile page at apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/(authlogin)/profile/page.tsx

## What to build

A professional profile page for the identity authority service. This page has DIRECT access to all user identity data because it owns the AuthProfile DynamoDB table.

## Data source
Fetch from GET /api/profile (the sibling task creates this endpoint).

## Layout — 5 sections, all using HeroUI Card components

### Section 1: Identity Header
- Card with avatar (lg, bordered, primary), displayName (rabbit_XXXX) as main heading
- Below: email with a small verified/unverified badge (CheckCircle icon green or X red)
- Right-aligned: quotaTier chip (upload=primary, admin=danger, zero=default)
- Subtitle row: "Member since {createdAt formatted}" in text-sm text-default-500

### Section 2: Linked Accounts (detailed view)
- Card titled "Linked Accounts"
- One sub-card or row per provider (Discord, GitHub, Strava) using consistent layout:
  - Left: Provider icon (use lucide or simple text label — Discord purple, GitHub gray, Strava orange)
  - Middle: Provider display name (discord.globalName or github.login or strava.firstName+lastName)
  - Below name: Masked email (from API response), "Linked {linkedAt}" relative date
  - Right: Green "Connected" chip
- Unlinked providers: Same row but grayed out, "Not Connected" chip (default color)
- NOTE: No "connect" buttons — linking happens through the login flow, not a profile action

### Section 3: Authorized Services
- Card titled "Services"
- Horizontal chip list: each service as a flat chip
- Colors: auth=primary, run=primary, strava=warning, gpxstudio=secondary, admin=danger
- Below chips: small text "Services control which defcon.run apps you can access"

### Section 4: Session & Security
- Card titled "Security"
- Rows (icon + label + value pattern from current debug page):
  - Session Version: {number}
  - Session Expires: {formatted date}
  - Account Status: "Active" (success) or "Locked: {reason}" (danger)
- "Sign Out" button (danger flat, bottom of card)
- Future: "Invalidate All Sessions" button (wired to existing /api/admin/user/{id}/invalidate-sessions)

### Section 5: Debug (collapsible, collapsed by default)
- Collapsible card titled "Developer Info"
- User ID in font-mono text-xs (with copy-to-clipboard)
- Raw session JSON in pre/code block (same as current dashboard)

## Styling rules
- Import from @heroui/react, NOT from @components/text-effects
- Use lucide-react icons (same set as current: User, Mail, Shield, Clock, CheckCircle, Layers, LogOut, ChevronDown, ChevronRight)
- Max width: max-w-2xl mx-auto (centered, not full-width)
- Spacing: space-y-4 between cards
- All text: use Tailwind classes directly (text-lg font-semibold, text-sm text-default-500, etc.)
- No Heading/Text component imports

## Key files to reference
- Current dashboard (to cannibalize): apps/run.auth/webapp/src/app/(authlogin)/page.tsx
- This reuses the (authlogin) layout which already handles auth redirects
